subject: MAP orientation: cadence, success metrics, and decision checkpoints
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@calyxhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP orientation: cadence, success metrics, and decision checkpoints

Hi Jamie —

Great to connect yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together an initial mutual action plan (attached) and a short evaluation scope to orient teams. High-level proposal:

- Cadence: Weekly 30-minute MAP checkpoint (recurring); working sessions as-needed for integration.
- Success criteria (initial): functional prototype ingesting sample data + stable latency under 350ms p95 for 99% of eval queries + qualitative quality score >= 4/5 on prioritized prompts.
- Decision checkpoints: MVP demo (Week 4), cost review (Week 6), production roll readiness (Week 10).

Immediate asks for this week:
1) Confirm stakeholders who will attend the weekly sync (technical POC + product owner)
2) Confirm data access window and any redaction needs so we can scope the eval dataset
3) Agree on the proposed weekly cadence and time slot (I suggest Mondays, 11:00 AM PT)

Attachments: Calyx_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (MAP tracker), evaluation_scope.pdf (scope & acceptance tests)

I'll add a HubSpot link and a shared tracker once the stakeholders are confirmed.

Thanks,

Soogin Lee
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP orientation: cadence, success metrics, and decision checkpoints

Thanks, Soojin — this looks like a helpful starting point. A couple quick notes:

- Please add our ML engineer Sam Patel (sam.patel@calyxhealth.com) to the thread — he'll drive the evaluation and infra access.
- We will need to run your security questionnaire against our procurement checklist; can you confirm who on your side owns the security responses?

On the cadence, Mondays at 11:00 AM PT should work for leadership/POs for the first few weeks.

Also attaching our security questionnaire for your team to review (calyx_security_questionnaire.xlsx).

Thanks — Jamie
Jamie Torres
Head of Product, Calyx Health
